description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthConnectionViewList class, which extends ViewList and customizes its list view preparation within the SuiteCRM framework. It appears to control display aspects such as disabling export and empty data messages for a specific list view.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthConnectionViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to customize the list view for external OAuth connections, particularly disabling export and empty data messages.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prepare the list view display parameters, setting export to false and hiding empty data messages.
